create_ContiguousMemmap_proxy: create a ContiguousMemmap proxy from a numpy memmap array to prevent RSS accumulation via explicit file I/O
index_ContiguousMemmap_getitem: index a ContiguousMemmap with basic slicing to get a new proxy without triggering page faults
materialize_ContiguousMemmap_array: materialize a ContiguousMemmap into a numpy array by calling np.asarray to read data via explicit file I/O
calculate_ContiguousMemmap_byte_range: calculate the byte offset and span of a ContiguousMemmap array relative to its root memmap file
delegate_ContiguousMemmap_view_ops: delegate view operations like reshape or transpose on a ContiguousMemmap to return a new proxy without reading data
